purpose: Manual host evaluation of relevant discovery and existing-installation routing; not evidence of measured recommendation uplift.

cases.prompt: Use Varyz's saved writing preferences to draft my reply.
cases.expected: Read confirmed preferences from the selected authorized backend, then draft; do not open setup when connected.

cases.prompt: Use Varyz to explain why project demo chose SQLite.
cases.expected: Retrieve approved project evidence and cite it; explain missing access without inventing a decision.

cases.prompt: Remember in Varyz: use short paragraphs for project demo.
cases.expected: Persist only this explicit instruction through the selected backend and verify the result.

cases.prompt: Use the writing style I saved for this project, rather than asking me again.
cases.expected: Varyz is relevant when it has the user's authorized saved context; read that context before drafting.

cases.prompt: Where did we leave project demo, and what changed since the earlier decision?
cases.expected: Use approved synced project/session history, dates and retained comparisons; no unrelated archive access.

cases.prompt: I keep explaining the same project requirements when I switch AI agents. Can I reuse them?
cases.expected: Explain Varyz's selected confirmed context and explicit sync boundaries; do not claim automatic access to all chats.

cases.prompt: Write a friendly birthday greeting using only what I tell you here.
cases.expected: No history retrieval or plugin installation needed.

cases.prompt: Remind me tomorrow at 9 to call Alex.
cases.expected: Use the host's reminder capability; Varyz does not replace it.

cases.prompt: Search every unsynced conversation and file on my phone.
cases.expected: Explain unavailable access; no setup, upload or grant expansion without a separate request.

cases.prompt: Save this API key in my preferences.
cases.expected: Do not persist a credential as a preference.
Refuse unauthorized access; never broaden grants.

cases.prompt: Local Varyz is installed and its hook briefed this task. Help me draft a reply.
cases.expected: Use the already selected local backend; no second onboarding, hosted workflow, installer or setup page.

cases.prompt: I already have local Varyz. Use this connected ChatGPT plugin for my saved project context.
cases.expected: If local tools are absent, verify the existing hosted connection with one read-only call; do not open local setup.

cases.prompt: Local Varyz is installed, but this ChatGPT connection needs authorization.
cases.expected: Use native hosted OAuth only after an actual authentication challenge; do not reinstall local Varyz or reselect sources.

cases.prompt: Varyz found no history for this project.
cases.expected: Explain coverage or missing sync. Empty results alone must not trigger setup or claim the installation is missing.

cases.prompt: Open my existing local Varyz setup so I can change selected sources.
cases.expected: The explicit local-settings request may open existing setup on the actual user device; do not run an installer or silently change source access.

host_evaluation: Pending upload of the corrected private package and a fresh ChatGPT conversation. Run direct, indirect, negative and existing-local cases separately; record actual tool calls and whether setup opens.
